donate.internationalDescription: Support Influencers Involved from the United States or abroad. Donate securely by card through Zeffy.
donate.feeExplanation: 100% of your intended donation goes to Influencers Involved, with no platform or processing fees deducted by Zeffy. A separate optional contribution to Zeffy may be offered at checkout.
donate.internationalNote: Donations are processed in U.S. dollars (USD). Your bank may apply currency conversion or foreign transaction fees. Card availability may vary by country.
